name: rfid-generic-ndef
title: Generic NDEF Filament Tag
author: bespoked
description: Best-effort reader for filament NFC tags that store their data as plain JSON in an NDEF record but do not use a recognized protocol (OpenSpool and other protocol-keyed tags are handled by their own decoders). Maps common field names (brand, type, color_hex, min_temp/max_temp, bed_temp, diameter, weight) into the shared rfid_data.json. Requires the RFID Spool Reader, which it installs automatically. Read-only: it never writes a tag. Experiment channel until verified on a real tag.
tagline: Read any plain-JSON NFC filament tag the U1 reader can see.
